pointwise_formula: For zero travel, the principal term is kernel(r=n,k=n, psi=x.1, source=x.2, w_i=v_i.1).
For n=m+1, the i-th source-variation term is kernel(r=m,k=m, psi=x.1, source=v_i.2, w_j=(v (i.succAbove j)).1).
The finite sum of those actual circle elements equals J.D n x v by the public scalar formula and injectivity of M.decode. No Schwarz permutation or arbitrary representative is needed.
At n=0 the source-variation sum is empty. Keep this case explicit.
removed_slot_proof: Apply Fin.prod_univ_succAbove to a scalar function f' with f'(i)=1 and f'(j)=f(j) for j!=i.
Finset.prod_erase with f'(i)=1 and prod_congr on univ.erase i identifies its erased product with the full product of f'.
Fin.succAbove_ne reduces the remaining factors to f(i.succAbove j). This proof never divides by f(i) and remains valid when any decoded direction is zero.
Only a scalar product is filled with 1. Do not introduce a constant-one circle element, which need not belong to the weighted circle space.
fixed_base_numerics: Take the pair B=b and global ell from coupled_circle_kernel_grading_bounds, whose quantifiers are existential b,ell before r,k,s,R.
Use Rplus=max(1,R). On the unit p_B polydisc of increments, the principal kernel majorant is at most Rplus*(1+p_high x+sum_i p_high(v_i)).
Each source-variation kernel majorant is at most 1+p_high x+sum_i p_high(v_i). Raise its derivative index (n-1)+s+ell to high=s+n+ell using monotonicity.
The numerical constant is Rplus*Cprincipal+n*Cvariation. It depends on n,s,R and the fixed model data, not travel, x, selectors, a tower choice, or the number of components.
Apply multilinear_bound_of_unitBall to the actual CML J.D n x with low=p_B, high=p_(s+n+ell), a=1+p_(s+n+ell)x. This preserves B and handles the kernel of the low seminorm.

circleShiftedChartComposeLinear_eq_zero_travel together with circleShiftedChartComposeContinuousLinear_apply gives F_t=F_0 o A_t.
The public translation grading contraction gives p_s(A_t x)<=p_s x at every s, with no travel-dependent constant.
Precompose the zero-travel genuine tower, use its exact jet formula, tameJetSize_linear_contraction, and uniqueness against the supplied J. Consequently C is selected before t and J.
This avoids proving a new derivative/translation commutation lemma and avoids the weaker old uniform-family wrapper.

exact_existing_signatures.kernel:
theorem coupled_circle_kernel_grading_bounds :
    ∃ base loss : ℕ, ∀ (r k s : ℕ) (R : ℝ), 1 ≤ R →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ ψ : M.Space, M.grading base ψ ≤ R →
        ∀ (v : M.Space) (w : Fin k → M.Space),
          M.grading s (coupledCircleKernel hD hT hγ hM hI r k ψ v w) ≤
            C * coupledCircleKernelMajorant M base (r + s + loss) ψ (Fin.cons v w)
exact_existing_signatures.genuine_forward_tower:
theorem exists_circleChartComposition_smoothDirections
    (hS : IsCircleModel T γ S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hD : IsAccumulatingProfile D) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hinterp : HasInterpolation S.grading) (travel : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∃ J : SmoothDirections univ
      (fun x : S.Space × S.Space =>
        circleShiftedChartComposeContinuousLinear hS hT hD hγ travel x.1 x.2),
      ∀ n x (v : Fin n → S.Space × S.Space),
        S.decode (J.D n x v) = circleChartCompositionJets hS travel n x v
exact_existing_signatures.actual_raw_increment:
theorem N01Properties.sectorCoefficientTower_bound
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε) (k s : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ ∀ m i a b p (hab : a + b ≤ s) (hp : p.1 ∈ D.cells m),
      ∀ z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε, ∀ v : Fin k → (StateDirections S × ℝ),
        |(hN.sectorCoefficientTower m i a b p hp).D k z v| ≤
          B * T.H (T.sample m) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * T.E0 (T.sample m) ^ B *
          oneHighVariationWeight (pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading)
            base (s + loss) z v
exact_existing_signatures.actual_original_speed:
theorem N01Properties.minusCharacteristicSpeed_strip_joint_growth
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (j : ℕ → ℕ) (hcell : ∀ m, Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells (j m))
    (l h : ℕ → ℝ) (hl : ∀ m, C.left m < l m) (hh : ∀ m, h m < C.right m)
    {lam P : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hpositive : ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, ∀ (m : ℕ) (p : PolarPoint),
      p.1 ∈ Ioo (l m) (h m) →
      let d := lam * radialE (D.cellIndex (j m)) ^ (-P) / 2
      d ≤ (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p ∧
      d ^ 2 ≤ (originalCoefficients D S C z).b p ^ 2 -
        (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p * (originalCoefficients D S C z).c p)
    (K : ∀ m, SmoothDirections
      (sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε ×ˢ (Ioo (l m) (h m) ×ˢ univ))
      (fun x : (StateDirections S × ℝ) × PolarPoint =>
        minusCharacteristicSpeed (originalCoefficients D S C (liftSectorParameter S C x.1)) x.2)) :
    ∃ B L : ℕ, base ≤ B ∧ loss ≤ B ∧
      UniformWeightedJointGrowth (pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading)
        (fun m => radialE (D.cellIndex (j m))) K B L
exact_existing_signatures.actual_residual_identity:
theorem N01Properties.sectorReturnResidualCircle_eq_of_N02
    (z : StateDirections S × ℝ) (hz : z ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε) :
    hN.sectorReturnResidualCircle hS hT z = R.residual (liftSectorParameter S C z)
exact_existing_signatures.product_fixed_orders:
theorem circleProduct_oneHigh_bound
    (hS : IsCircleModel T γ S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hD : IsAccumulatingProfile D) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hinterp : HasInterpolation S.grading) :
    ∃ base loss : ℕ, ∀ s, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u v : S.Space,
      S.grading s (circleProductBilinear hS hT hD hγ u v) ≤
        C * (S.grading (s + loss) u * S.grading base v +
          S.grading base u * S.grading (s + loss) v)
